analytical_check.kind: tiny own Python stdlib scalar/enumeration analysis, no EDA/training
analytical_check.code:
import itertools,random,json,math
masks=[m for m in itertools.product([0,1],repeat=4) if m[2]<=m[0] and m[3]<=m[1]]
assert len(masks)==9
obs=sum(2**sum(m) for m in masks);assert obs==49
rng=random.Random(301);maxloss=0;maxgrad=0;maxregret=0
for _ in range(1000):
 ec,ed=[rng.uniform(-3,3) for _ in range(2)]
 for a,b in itertools.product([0.,1.],repeat=2):
  direct=a*(ec+ed)**2+b*(ec-ed)**2
  transformed=(a+b)*(ec*ec+ed*ed)+2*(a-b)*ec*ed
  maxloss=max(maxloss,abs(direct-transformed))
  gc=2*a*(ec+ed)+2*b*(ec-ed);gd=2*a*(ec+ed)-2*b*(ec-ed)
  maxgrad=max(maxgrad,abs(gc-(2*(a+b)*ec+2*(a-b)*ed)),abs(gd-(2*(a+b)*ed+2*(a-b)*ec)))
 vals=[rng.uniform(-5,5) for _ in range(32)];pred=[v+rng.uniform(-1,1) for v in vals]
 regret=max(vals)-vals[max(range(32),key=pred.__getitem__)]
 maxregret=max(maxregret,regret-2*max(abs(v-p) for v,p in zip(vals,pred)))
assert maxloss<1e-12 and maxgrad<1e-12 and maxregret<1e-12
relu=lambda x:max(x,0)
witness=[[relu(i-j+1)-2*relu(i-j)+relu(i-j-1) for j in range(3)] for i in range(3)]
assert witness==[[1,0,0],[0,1,0],[0,0,1]]
print(json.dumps({'masks':[''.join(map(str,m)) for m in masks],'observation_submasks':obs,'trials':1000,'max_loss_difference':maxloss,'max_gradient_difference':maxgrad,'max_positive_regret_bound_violation':maxregret,'relu_witness':witness},indent=2))
